commonAcceptance: The playable rule model must implement the named core mechanic in proposal; changing theme/text around an unrelated generic puzzle is unacceptable.

Mobile-first Traditional Chinese interface; clear objective, visual state, legal controls, feedback, pause/restart where applicable, keyboard equivalent where practical, and no horizontal overflow at 360px.
If levelBased=true: exactly 100 selectable, meaningfully varied levels with stable IDs; structural or task variation beyond renaming, relabeling, symmetry or cosmetic recoloring.
Every advertised solvable level needs a replayable action/input witness executed through the same runtime engine, plus independent rule/property assertions; invalid or empty witness must fail.
In-app contextual hints and visible solution demonstrations use legal engine transitions. Demo/hint completion is marked assisted and never awards unassisted records.

Challenge proof claims distinguish legal reachability, fixed-policy opponent scenarios, timing witnesses and full adversarial forced wins; never claim unique solutions or arbitrary-opponent wins without evidence.
State-dependent local AI only: actual opponent/teammate decisions consume permitted observations, have legal-action tests, and are not a canned transcript or a random move labeled intelligent.
Reset, level change, leaving screen and repeated input cancel stale timers/AI/demo work; persistence is validated and separate per game.
No third-party LLM/API, account, network multiplayer claim or external media dependency. Audio only begins after user gesture and has mute/volume controls when used.
README accurately documents variant, controls, objective, solution proof scope, AI policy and limitations; tests must run against exact submitted sources.
